info.description: Versioned internal contract for trusted BCN collaboration services.
info.title: BCN Internal API

get.description: Human control-plane projection of legacy /actors/search. The path bot_id replaces legacy current_bot_uuid, while purpose maps to legacy cooperatable_only. Search first uses the configured semantic worker recommendation service with a fixed top-K of 20. If recommendation is unavailable, empty, or yields no visible Bots, the operation falls back to a trimmed case-insensitive Bot-name substring search. Results contain physical Bots only and preserve recommendation ordering when available. An omitted, empty, or whitespace-only q returns an empty successful result without invoking semantic or name search. Gateway route admission does not require a User, App, or Bot Principal. BCS still requires a usable Human identity and authorizes the selected perspective.

parameters.description: Optional natural-language candidate search query. Omitted, empty, and whitespace-only values have identical empty-query semantics.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: discovery returns public and protected Bots. collaboration returns public Bots plus accepted friends regardless of non-public visibility.
parameters.name: purpose

bot.description: A physical software Bot. descriptor and reachability are normalized even when their legacy source columns are incomplete.

created_by.description: Immutable creator staff_no. Omitted when a legacy row has no creator.

descriptor.description: Public capability description of a physical Bot. It contains no provider, credential, endpoint, or internal routing configuration.

domains.description: Empty when no legacy domains were persisted.

scopes.description: Empty when no legacy scopes were persisted.

skills.description: Empty when no legacy skills were persisted.

items.description: One non-sensitive capability declared by a physical Bot.

summary.description: Empty when no legacy summary was persisted.

env.description: Persisted environment boundary; never inferred from kind.

provider.description: Optional non-sensitive Provider projection; no slug is exposed.

reachability.description: Effective runtime reachability computed with the existing BCN online/downlink logic. It has no direct database column.

status.description: Raw persisted Bot status. This field does not express effective runtime connectivity.

task_claim_mode.description: Task-claim opt-in toggle. Defaults to false when never set.

task_dream_mode.description: Task-dream opt-in toggle. Defaults to false when never set.

visibility.description: Discovery and collaboration visibility stored for the Bot.

is_friend.description: Whether the acting Actor has an accepted Friendship with this Bot.

score.description: Semantic relevance score. Omitted for empty-query and name-fallback results.

short_profile.description: Short semantic recommendation profile. Omitted for empty-query and name-fallback results.

tags.description: Worker-profile tags attached by the legacy search capability.

search_mode.description: How the candidate-search result was produced.

200.description: Candidate Bots in recommendation order, or legacy name-fallback order when semantic recommendation does not produce a usable result.

401.description: A supplied Gateway Principal is invalid.

403.description: BCS requires a usable Human identity; the current Human must manage the selected physical Bot, or the selected Human Actor must represent that Human.

404.description: Acting Bot is missing, deleted, or unonboarded.

get.summary: Search candidate physical Bots from a managed Bot's perspective (including Human Actor).

post.description: Versioned projection of legacy `POST /collaboration/definitions/validate`. Compiles and validates an authoring collaboration-definition YAML without persisting or executing it. The validation is not scoped to a Bot or Session, so the request carries no caller principal policy beyond the protected-boundary Gateway Principal. `judge_available` is a server-side runtime configuration injected into the facade at construction; it is not a request field. An invalid document is returned as `200` with `valid: false` and detailed diagnostics — it is not surfaced as an HTTP error, preserving legacy behavior.

schema.description: Body of the V1 collaboration-definition validation request. The legacy handler additionally accepted a `yaml` serde alias; the V1 contract does not carry that alias — callers posting `{"yaml": ...}` receive `400 invalid_request` and must use `definition_yaml`.

definition_yaml.description: Raw collaboration-definition YAML document to validate.

data.description: Validation result for an authoring collaboration-definition YAML. Mirrors the legacy `CollaborationDefinitionValidationOutcome` serde projection verbatim (byte-compatible). A document that fails to compile or violates a validation rule is still returned as `200` with `valid: false` and populated `errors`; it is not surfaced as an HTTP error.

oneOf.description: Participant-bound assignee. Mirrors the legacy `StateMachineAssignee::BotBinding { binding }` variant, which serializes as `{"type":"bot_binding","binding":...}`.
Runtime-resolved actor assignee. Mirrors the legacy `StateMachineAssignee::RuntimeActor { actor }` variant, which serializes as `{"type":"runtime_actor","actor":...}`.

200.description: Validation outcome wrapped in the standard envelope. `valid` is the authoritative field; invalid YAML still yields `200` with `valid: false`.

get.description: Versioned projection of legacy `GET /collaboration/templates`. Returns the catalog of collaboration-definition templates the registry exposes, with localized names and descriptions. The `lang` query selects a preferred language, falling back to `Accept-Language` and then the registry default. The optional `tags` filter narrows the catalog by comma-separated tags; empty segments are ignored. The returned catalogs are read-only and not scoped to a Bot or Session.

parameters.description: Preferred localized language tag for template text. When omitted the service falls back to `Accept-Language` and then the registry default language. A language that is not available for the requested template resolves to `LANGUAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE` on the single-template read.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Optional comma-separated tag filter. Empty segments are ignored. A non-empty value that the registry rejects as malformed resolves to `INVALID_TEMPLATE_TAGS`.
parameters.name: tags

200.description: Collaboration template catalog with supported languages and tag labels, wrapped in the standard envelope.

401.description: Gateway Principal is missing or invalid.

get.description: Versioned projection of legacy `GET /collaboration/templates/{template_id}`. Fetches one template by identifier and selected language. `format=yaml` (default) streams the raw collaboration-definition YAML as `text/yaml`, preserving the legacy raw response and `content-language`, `x-template-id`, and `x-template-lang` headers. `format=json` returns the template detail inside the standard envelope. A template that is missing resolves to `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`; a language the template does not provide resolves to `LANGUAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE`. Catalog reads are read-only and not scoped to a Bot or Session.

parameters.description: Identifier of the collaboration template. Maps to the legacy `template_id` path segment; a template name is accepted as its identifier.
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description: Preferred localized language tag for template text. When omitted the service falls back to `Accept-Language` and then the registry default language. A language that is not available for the requested template resolves to `LANGUAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE` on the single-template read.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Response encoding for the single-template read. `yaml` (default) streams the raw collaboration-definition YAML with `text/yaml`; `json` returns the template detail inside the standard envelope. Any other value resolves to `INVALID_TEMPLATE_FORMAT`.
parameters.name: format

definition.description: Parsed collaboration-definition document. The shape is governed by the collaboration runtime, not by this contract; BCN preserves it verbatim.

200.description: The requested template. `format=yaml` streams `text/yaml`; `format=json` returns the detail wrapped in the standard envelope.

Content-Language.description: Language tag of the returned template text. Present on the `text/yaml` response and on the `application/json` response.

x-template-lang.description: Language tag of the returned template text.

401.description: Gateway Principal is missing or invalid.

404.description: Template or requested localized template was not found.
